items.title: What Moderna Must Do to Take Its Stock to the Next Level
items.summary: Top executives at  Moderna  have been projecting high confidence in the commercial future of the company’s personalized cancer vaccine even as Wall Street holds out for complete trial results.  Moderna shares nearly tripled last Wednesday after a late-stage trial showed a treatment combining Moderna and  Merck’s  experimental vaccine, intismeran autogene, and Merck’s Keytruda was more effective at preventing skin cancer recurrence than Keytruda alone.  Moderna and Merck plan to share more details, including the hazard ratio and subgroup analyses, at an upcoming conference—likely the meeting of the European Society for Medical Oncology in late October.
